# Sources

`import { Sources } from "@/components/agent-ui/sources"`

## Use for
- The pages, files, or documents an assistant answer is based on.

## Do not use for
- Site navigation or a sidebar of chats. Use the project's nav.
- A file the user can open and read in full. Use `Artifact`.
- Inline mentions. Link those inside the `Message`.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `{ title, href, excerpt? }[]` | Required. `href` is a real URL. |
| `label` | `string` | Heading. Default `"Sources"`. Set it when the interface is not in English. |

## Example
```tsx
<Sources
  label="Sources"
  items={citations.map((item) => ({
    title: item.title,
    href: item.url,
    excerpt: item.snippet,
  }))}
/>
```

## Rules
- Render it after the `Message` it supports, as a sibling in the thread.
- One source per document. Do not repeat the same href.
- The excerpt is a short quote, not a second answer.
